name: ZHUANG.WENDI
bio: Based in Jingdezhen, a multidisciplinary media artist. Her practice spans ceramics, sound installation, video and live performance. Grounded in the local material experience of the porcelain capital, she explores the relationships between matter, sound and space. Centering on sensory experience, she weaves ceramic objects, sonic experiments and on‑site narratives together. Through residency projects, exhibitions and sound‑art workshops, she seeks to expand the boundaries of contemporary cross‑media expression upon the soil of traditional craft.
